body:
Proposing these: 

_2.7 Verify that password entry fields encourage and do not prevent the use of long passphrases or special characters_

_2.33 Verify the application does not prevent using paste features in password fields to maintain compatibility with browser-based and external password managers._

I thought the "unless prohibited by risk based policy" part was unnecessary because you could add that to the end of every requirement. 

Also some things I think should be addressed:

- Using the _password_ type element in form fields to ensure obscured passwords and prevent browsers from saving autofill info (seems like this shouldn't have to be said but I have been seeing an increasing number of applications use javascript to make custom password fields). 
- Avoid overly-complex password requirements

Finally, wouldn't 2.32 be an access control issue?
title: Various V2 proposed changes
